Price: €155,000
Published by: ORIZON VALENCIA

We present this unique opportunity in the heart of the Ayora / Albors neighborhood: a ground-floor commercial space in a privileged setting, with a drafted tourist project and an excellent location.

� Location: Calle José María Haro, in a pedestrian area facing a tree-lined park. No car traffic. Quiet, bright, and very pleasant environment.

✨ Features:

Built area: 75 m²

Current use: Industrial (warehouse)

Complete technical project for conversion into a tourist apartment

Independent entrance from a pedestrian street

High ceilings, wide facade

� Tourist project included:
It is delivered with a professional project already drafted to convert the premises into a modern 2-bedroom tourist apartment. The project is approved with the change of use already granted; we also have the building permit already paid for.

� Ideal for:

Investors looking for appreciation; only the renovation needs to be carried out to start generating profit.

Area with strong residential and rental demand due to its proximity to universities, hospitals, public transport, and the beach.

� More information or visit: ORIZON VALENCIA – Antonio Moreno Gallardo
� Héroe Romeu, 2 – Valencia
� Tel: 606 715 923.
